arabic_blocks: [625] حدثنا محمد بن عبد الله بن حوشب قال: حدثنا عبد الوهاب قال: حدثنا حميد عن أنس قال: قال النبي ﷺ يا بني سلمة ألا تحتسبون آثاركم، وقال مجاهد في قوله { ونكتب ما قدموا وآثارهم } قال خطاهم، وقال ابن أبي مريم أخبرنا يحيى بن أيوب حدثني حميد حدثني أنس أن بني سلمة أرادوا أن يتحولوا عن منازلهم فينزلوا قريبا من النبي ﷺ قال: فكره رسول الله ﷺ أن يعروا المدينة، فقال ألا تحتسبون آثاركم قال مجاهد خطاهم آثارهم أن يمشي في الأرض بأرجلهم
english_blocks: Muhammad ibn ‘Abd Allah ibn Hawshab related to us. He said: ‘Abd al-Wahhab related to us. He said: Humayd related to us, from Anas, who said: The Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, said:
“Banu Salimah, will you not seek reward for your footsteps?”
And Mujahid said concerning His words, “And We record what they have sent ahead and their traces”: He said: “Their footsteps.”
And Ibn Abi Maryam said: Yahya ibn Ayyub informed us. Humayd related to me. Anas related to me:

That Banu Salimah wanted to move from their homes and settle near the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace. He said: The Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, disliked their leaving Madinah deserted, and said: “Will you not seek reward for your footsteps?”
Mujahid said: “Their footsteps are their traces: walking on the earth with their feet.”

“No prayer is heavier upon the hypocrites than Fajr and ‘Isha’. If they knew what there is in them, they would come to them even crawling. I considered ordering the caller to give the iqamah, then ordering a man to lead the people, then taking flames of fire and setting fire to those who have not yet gone out to prayer.”

“Seven will Allah shade in His shade on a day when there is no shade except His shade: a just imam; a young person who grew up worshipping his Lord; a man whose heart is attached to the mosques; two men who loved one another for Allah’s sake, meeting on that basis and parting on that basis; a man whom a woman of rank and beauty sought, who said, ‘I fear Allah’; a man who gave charity and concealed it so that his left hand did not know what his right hand spent; and a man who remembered Allah alone, and his eyes overflowed.”

english_blocks: Qutaybah related to us. He said: Isma‘il ibn Ja‘far related to us, from Humayd, who said:
And Anas was asked: “Did the Messenger of Allah, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, have a ring?”

He said: “Yes. One night he delayed the ‘Isha’ prayer until halfway through the night. Then, after he had prayed, he turned his face towards us and said: ‘The people have prayed and slept, and you have continued to be in prayer since you began waiting for it.’” He said: “It is as though I am looking at the gleam of his ring.”

arabic_blocks: [631] حدثنا علي بن عبد الله قال: حدثنا يزيد بن هارون قال: أخبرنا محمد بن مطرف عن زيد بن أسلم عن عطاء بن يسار عن أبي هريرة عن النبي ﷺ قال: من غدا إلى المسجد وراح أعد الله له نزله من الجنة كلما غدا أو راح
english_blocks: ‘Ali ibn ‘Abd Allah related to us. He said: Yazid ibn Harun related to us. He said: Muhammad ibn Mutarrif informed us, from Zayd ibn Aslam, from ‘Ata’ ibn Yasar, from Abu Hurayrah, from the Prophet, may Allah bless him and grant him peace, who said:
“Whoever goes to the mosque in the morning and in the evening, Allah prepares hospitality for him in Paradise each time he goes in the morning or the evening.”
